dialog.title: Book an appointment with {{name}}
dialog.sub: Pick a one-hour slot: it is yours at once.

gate.toConfirm: Pick your slot, then sign in to book with {{name}}: your choice will be waiting when you come back.
gate.why: An account lets you find and cancel your appointments, and protects artists from fake bookings.

done.title: Appointment booked
done.body: You will receive a confirmation e-mail with the appointment to add to your calendar. The artist may contact you about your project.
done.cancel: Can't make it? Cancel from “My appointments”: it is free until 24 hours before.

design.title: Your design
design.chosenHint: {{name}} will get this design with your request.

when.title: Your slot
when.error: The slots could not be loaded.
when.closed: This calendar is not taking bookings at the moment.
when.none: No free slot in the coming days. Come back soon.
when.zoneOther: Note: {{city}} time, the artist's time zone.
when.weekEmpty: No free slot this week. Try the next one.
when.pick: Pick a free hour in the calendar.

fields.name: First and last name
fields.commentPlaceholder: Your idea, your questions, an inspiration…
fields.customHint: Describe your idea: shape, colour, tooth, inspiration…

problem.name: Enter your first and last name.
problem.comment: Describe your idea in the message.
problem.commentLength: The message is at most 1000 characters.

error.session_expired: Your session expired: sign in again, then try again.
error.email_unconfirmed: Confirm your e-mail address first (link sent when you signed up), then try again.
error.closed: This calendar is not taking bookings at the moment.
error.own_calendar: You cannot book in your own calendar.
error.slot_unavailable: This slot is no longer offered. Pick another one.
error.slot_taken: This slot was just booked. Pick another one.
error.limit_artist: You already have an upcoming appointment with this artist.
error.limit_total: You already have 3 upcoming appointments: that is the maximum.
error.limit_daily: Too many bookings today. Try again tomorrow.
error.banned: Bookings are closed to you for now, after missed appointments or late cancellations. See “My appointments”.
error.blocked: This artist does not take bookings from you.
error.item_unavailable: This design is no longer on the page. Pick another one.
error.captcha_required: The anti-robot check did not complete. Try again.
error.captcha_failed: The anti-robot check failed. Try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
error.unavailable: The booking could not be made. Try again in a moment.

info: Your booking, name, e-mail, phone and message are passed on to {{name}}, who will see you and may contact you. They are kept 12 months after the appointment.

viewer.title: Like this design?
viewer.body: Book a slot with {{name}} to have it applied.

artist.actionFailed: The action did not go through

codes.not_cancellable: This appointment can no longer be cancelled.
codes.not_markable: The outcome is recorded after the appointment's hour, and at most 60 days after.
codes.too_many_closures: You already have 20 periods to come: reopen one before adding another.

artist.clientErased: The client deleted their account: their details were erased.
artist.blockedDone: This client can no longer book with you
artist.blockBody: {{name}} will no longer be able to book with you, neither from your Glowbook page nor from your 3D creations. Appointments already booked are not cancelled. You can accept them again at any time from "My calendar" › Sync.
artist.cancelBody: Your client receives an e-mail with the reason you give. The slot is free again on your Glowbook.
artist.cancelled: Appointment cancelled, the client has been told

mine.title: My appointments
mine.description: The appointments you booked with artists. Cancelling is free until 24 hours before.
mine.findArtistBody: Find a tooth gem artist near you and book a slot on their page.
mine.unavailable: Appointments are not available at the moment.
mine.error: The appointments could not be loaded.
mine.banned: After two no-shows or late cancellations within 12 months, bookings are closed to you until {{date}}.
mine.noneUpcoming: No upcoming appointment. Book from an artist's page.
mine.cancelFree: The artist is told and the slot is free again.
mine.cancelLate: The appointment is less than 24 hours away: the cancellation will be recorded as late. Two no-shows or late cancellations within 12 months close bookings for 3 months.
mine.cancelled: Appointment cancelled, the artist has been told
mine.receivedMoved: The appointments clients book on your Glowbook are in your calendar.
mine.placeArea: The artist's area: the artist gives you the exact address.

agenda.savedOn: Bookings are open on your Glowbook as soon as it is approved.
agenda.unavailable: The calendar is not available at the moment.

status.switchOff: Bookings are paused on the platform for the moment.
status.disabled: Bookings are closed. Open them to offer your slots on your Glowbook.
status.pending: Your bookings will open as soon as your page is approved.
status.open: Bookings are open: your free slots are offered on your Glowbook.
status.closed: Bookings are closed: they need an active Atelier plan.

agenda.enableHint: Only signed-in members book. Each slot lasts 1 hour and is blocked for you as soon as it is booked; cancel those that do not suit you.

weekProblem.order: Each range must end after it starts.
weekProblem.overlap: Two ranges of the same day overlap.
weekProblem.tooMany: Too many ranges: 28 at most in the week.

agenda.linkNote: While bookings are open, the “Book” button of your page opens this calendar instead of your external booking link.
agenda.weekHint: {{city}} time. Tap an hour to close or open it: block here the appointments taken elsewhere, or let the import of your other calendar do it.
agenda.saveFirst: Save your settings to edit the week.
agenda.pastHint: After the hour, the appointment moves to “Past appointments to record”: say whether the client came.
agenda.toMarkHint: Did the client come? Record it within 60 days: two no-shows or late cancellations within 12 months close their bookings for 3 months.
agenda.openHint: Tap an appointment to see the client, the creation asked for and their comment.

feed.title: Sync with my calendar
feed.body: A private link to add to Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook: your Glowbook appointments show there, updated automatically.
feed.privacy: Your calendar will receive your clients' names, phones, e-mails and messages. Keep this link to yourself: anyone who knows it sees your appointments.
feed.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the link and copy it
feed.onlyOnce: This link is shown only once. If you lose it, create a new one.
feed.howGoogle: Google Calendar (on a computer): Other calendars › + › From URL, paste the link.
feed.howApple: Apple Calendar: File › New Calendar Subscription (on iPhone: Settings › Calendar › Accounts › Add Account › Other › Add Subscribed Calendar).
feed.howOutlook: Outlook: Add calendar › Subscribe from web, paste the link.
feed.refresh: Each app reads the link again on its own schedule: Google can take up to 24 hours. Cancellations disappear at the next read.
feed.active: A calendar link has been active since {{date}}. To see it again, create a new one: the old one will stop working.
feed.rotateBody: The old link will stop working: replace it with the new one in your calendars.
feed.disableBody: Your calendars will no longer receive your appointments. You can create a new link later.

import.title: Block the hours taken elsewhere
import.body: Paste the private link of another calendar: the hours it is busy in are closed automatically on your Glowbook, every 15 minutes.
import.label: Link of your other calendar (.ics)
import.howGoogle: Google Calendar (on a computer): Settings › your calendar › “Secret address in iCal format”, copy it.
import.howPlanity: Planity: ask their support whether a .ics calendar link exists; otherwise, close your Planity slots by hand in the week above.
import.howOther: Apple, Outlook or another: use the calendar's publish or subscribe link (it starts with https:// or webcal://).
import.privacy: Only the busy hours are kept: never the title, place or guests of your appointments. An hour you opened or closed by hand stays as you chose.
import.savedBody: The busy hours will be closed within 15 minutes.
import.removed: Link removed: the imported hours are open again
import.invalid: The link must start with https:// or webcal://.

errors.unreachable: Could not read it on {{date}}: the link does not answer. Check it is still valid. Hours already closed stay closed.
errors.not_calendar: Could not read it on {{date}}: this link does not give a .ics calendar.
errors.too_large: Could not read it on {{date}}: this calendar is too large (2 MB at most).
errors.forbidden_host: This link is not accepted: it must be a public https address.
errors.timeout: Could not read it on {{date}}: the calendar took too long to answer. Another try in 15 minutes.

page.title: My calendar
page.description: Your appointments, hours and time off, in one place. Clients book from your Glowbook.
page.lockedTitle: The calendar comes with the Atelier plan
page.lockedBody: With the Atelier plan, clients book a slot from your Glowbook, and you manage your appointments, hours and time off here.
page.noPageBody: Bookings are made from your Glowbook page: create it, then come back to open your calendar.
page.planEnded: Your plan no longer includes the calendar: bookings are closed. You can still handle the appointments already booked here.

closures.title: Close days
closures.hint: Holidays, a training, the salon closed: close whole days at once. No slot is offered on those days, not even an hour opened by hand or free in your other calendar.
closures.addedNone: No slot will be offered on those days.
closures.removeFailed: The period could not be reopened.

problem.past: A period starts today at the earliest.
problem.order: The end is the same day as the start, or later.
problem.tooFar: A period lasts a year at most and ends within the coming year.
problem.note: The note is 80 characters at most.

closures.cancelHint: Appointments already booked on those days are cancelled and each client is e-mailed ("The artist has closed their calendar on that day"). Your note is not sent.
closures.addedCancelled_one: {{count}} appointment cancelled: the client is e-mailed.
closures.addedCancelled_other: {{count}} appointments cancelled: the clients are e-mailed.
closures.confirmTitle_one: Close these days and cancel {{count}} appointment?
closures.confirmTitle_other: Close these days and cancel {{count}} appointments?
closures.confirmBody_one: One appointment is already booked on those days. It will be cancelled and the client e-mailed: "The artist has closed their calendar on that day". This cannot be undone.
closures.confirmBody_other: {{count}} appointments are already booked on those days. They will be cancelled and each client e-mailed: "The artist has closed their calendar on that day". This cannot be undone.
